诚然，一个实力不可估量的烈火一号，一个实力达到S级的土系异能者，再加上三个蛮横的罗斯蛮子，这样的组合，足够让他们头疼了。

“哈哈！不错、不错，这次出现了几匹黑马，刀长空，吴断山，上官蓝沁这三匹黑马不知谁强谁弱！”一个长老开口，眼睛一直盯着下方一个演武台上。

可是，他们什么也看不到，只能看到金光肆虐，一道道金色光束爆开，这结界隔绝一切魂念探查，以他们如今的目力，真的看不清里面到底发生了什么，金光实在是太刺目了。

胡冰冰：没错，我初来乍到香港有很多事情还不明白，还得慢慢熟悉呢。

只不过在黄忠等人要进行商谈的时候，向天让黑冰台成员送来了他的命令，突然出现的黑冰台成员，自然是得到了黄忠等人的注视。

苏桓抬眼望去，这是在给自己树立一个射击靶子吗？那简直是太好了。对方这么配合，这么善解人意，那自己也就不客气了。

一看，果然令他大失所望，鼎内的丹药，大多还是上品，离晋升极品还有很大的距离，只有以前一直放在里面的是极品。

“好，我立刻就回来！”回了一句，白恨秋腾空而起，兴奋的化作一道长虹消失了在天际。

干掉M先生，虽然是一个很有诱惑的想法，但金戈并没有太高的期望值。

可是现在的夜色，光亮并不充足，故而夏侯惇也没有看到张郃甲胄上的痕迹，不过现在正在交战，就算有所疑惑只能够之后了。

轻轻的三声敲门声音响了起来。掇刀便向着宁枫挑了挑眉毛，示意接下来赶你出场了。

主持人将规则简单的说了一些，其实这些信息大家在学生卡里都能查得到，不过那些没有参加比赛的人却不一定会知道这么多。

看了看望不到顶的天山，宁枫叹了一口气，便开始向着上面爬了起来。

他看上去清瘦了很多，下巴上也浮现起了些许凌乱的胡渣，让他显得有些邋遢。

龙威散发之下，面前的避障竟是被削弱了，近乎于无，两人就这样轻松的漫步走入了龙族城堡。

It is true that the combination of a Fiery One with immeasurable strength, an earth superpower with S-level strength, and three arrogant Ross barbarians is enough to give them a headache.

"Haha! Yes, yes, there are several dark horses appearing this time. Dao Changkong, Wu Duanshan, and Shangguan Lanqin are the three dark horses. I don't know who is stronger and who is weaker!" An elder said, staring at a martial arts stage below.

However, they could see nothing but golden light raging and golden beams of light exploding. This barrier blocked all soul exploration. With their current eyesight, they really couldn't see clearly what was going on inside. The golden light was too dazzling.

Hu Bingbing: Yes, there are many things I don’t understand when I first came to Hong Kong, and I have to get familiar with them gradually.

However, when Huang Zhong and others were about to discuss, Xiangtian asked the members of Heibingtai to send his orders. The members of Heibingtai who suddenly appeared naturally attracted the attention of Huang Zhong and others.

Su Huan looked up, was he setting up a shooting target for himself?That's just great.If the other party is so cooperative and considerate, then I won't be polite.

At first glance, he was really disappointed. Most of the elixirs in the cauldron were still top-grade, and there was still a long way to go before being promoted to the top-grade. Only the pills that had been placed in it before were top-grade.

"Okay, I'll be back right away!" He replied, Bai Henqiu soared into the sky, and excitedly turned into a rainbow and disappeared into the sky.

Although killing Mr. M was a very tempting idea, Jin Ge did not have high expectations.

However, there was not enough light in the night now, so Xiahou Dun did not see the marks on Zhang He's armor. However, since they were fighting now, even if they had doubts, they could only wait.

There were three soft knocks on the door.He raised his eyebrows at Ning Feng with his sword in hand, signaling that he would kick you out next.

The host briefly explained the rules. In fact, everyone can check this information in the student card, but those who have not participated in the competition may not know so much.

After looking at the Tianshan Mountains that reached the top, Ning Feng sighed and began to climb up.

He looked much thinner, and some messy stubble appeared on his chin, making him look a bit sloppy.

Under the dragon's power, the obstacles in front of them were weakened to almost nothing, and the two of them strolled into the Dragon Castle easily.
